source.limitations: Transcribed from Wyandot County Public Health Septage Haulers PDF (2026-SEWAGE-HAULERS.pdf; footer 09/21/2026; 10 TOTAL), linked as Approved Septic Haulers from the Forms page. Publisher block on the PDF: 127-A SOUTH SANDUSKY AVENUE, UPPER SANDUSKY, OH 43351, Phone 1-419-294-3852, Fax 1-419-294-6424. Spellings kept as printed, including MR. FIXALL HANDYMAN SERVICES, LLC DBA MR. FIX and MT SERVICES INC DBA MILLER PORTABLES. MT SERVICES INC DBA MILLER PORTABLES has no operator name line (operator null). SMOKEY'S MINI LAKE CAMPGROUNDS phone is printed as - - - (phone null; no number invented). Street and city lines are joined with a space as printed. No local registration numbers on this PDF. ODH statewide bond status is not on this PDF (marked unknown). The Home Sewage Treatment topic page still links SEWAGE-TREATMENT-04-24-2025.pdf (footer 04/24/2025, 11 TOTAL); that older roster was not transcribed and was not merged. Installer and service-provider lists were not merged. A septage hauler registration is not a service-provider inspection credential. Appearance is not an endorsement. Verify with Wyandot County Public Health and ODH before you hire.
